title: News report: survivors of the plane crash at Jamaica Hospital
summary: unnamed news reporter tells of News report: survivors of the plane crash at Jamaica Hospital, about unspecified at Jamaica Hospital, New York, and reports it citing named sources. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they have received here at Jamaica Hospital, they've received 14 survivors from the plane crash.

plain: A news report, played on a podcast episode about a supposed secret Nazi UFO program, says that Jamaica Hospital in New York had received 14 survivors from a plane crash. The clip gives no more detail about when or which crash it was.
